script: My wealthy father refused help—now I am fighting brain cancer alone, stunned.. I am 30, living at my parents' place, and it's been three years of fighting an ultra‑rare brain cancer. My brain's gone on a full‑on crash‑course—recurrences, radiation, headaches, nausea—so I am basically a walking, thinking, exhausted mess. Back in 2023 I had to move back in after a craniotomy. I couldn't keep up with the grind to pay rent or take care of myself, so I am grateful for the roof, but it's a constant reminder that I am stuck. I work 12 hours a week max, just enough to stay afloat, but that's barely enough to cover the bills my dad forces me to pay. Dad's a straight‑up mogul—his biz is about to sell for $40 million, split three ways. Yet he's all "I came from nothing, nobody helped me, look where I am at." So he refuses to drop a dime. He keeps telling me to "find help elsewhere." I am on Medicaid, just finished a SNAP interview, have no savings, and can't even work a normal shift because of the chemo fatigue. I am talking about applying for disability, but it's a long shot. I am getting mad. I am not a kid who thinks parents owe me anything. I am doing what I can: working, doing chores, pulling my weight. But while I am stuck in survival mode, he's splurging hundreds on trivial things. It's like, bro, you're a millionaire and I am struggling for groceries? I am tired, defeated, and honestly, I am starting to feel bitter. I just needed a vent. I've been talking to a therapist, but I wanted another outlet. Thanks for listening, for the support, and for calling out my dad's attitude. I am not crazy for asking for help, and I am going to keep pushing through whatever comes next. xx
